use_CustomAutoSummary_class: use the CustomAutoSummary class to generate Sphinx autosummary tables with optional toctree hiding
configure_hide_from_toctree_option: configure the hide_from_toctree option to exclude autosummary entries from the left sidebar toctree
run_CustomAutoSummary_run_method: run the CustomAutoSummary run method to parse content names and generate documentation table nodes
set_autosummary_caption_option: set the caption option on CustomAutoSummary to add a title to the generated autosummary table
use_toctree_with_template_option: use the toctree and template options together to generate stub docs with custom templates
